title: Koszul dual of a Koszul-regular immersion
statement: Let i:Z\to Y be a Koszul-regular closed immersion of codimension d between Noetherian schemes [def-pc-scheme], meaning that locally its defining ideal is generated by a Koszul-regular sequence [def-weil-pbc-koszul-regular-sequence]. Let C_i be the conormal sheaf of i [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf] pulled back to Z [def-pc-module-pullback], and let N_i:=\operatorname{SheafHom}_{\mathcal O_Z}(C_i,\mathcal O_Z) be the normal sheaf. Let c be the right adjoint to Ri_* on quasi-coherent derived categories [def-pc-derived-category]. Then c(\mathcal O_Y) is canonically isomorphic to \bigwedge^d N_i[-d] in the derived category of quasi-coherent complexes on Z.
